governs.successor_work: Garden v15.6 and later until superseded by a separately admitted ProcessVersion

cycle_binding.mid_cycle_process_or_design_epoch_change: Either finish only under an explicitly permitted grandfathering receipt or terminate and create a new CycleID bound to the new state; never rewrite an existing CycleID binding.

authoritative_semantics.earlier_v1_0_v1_1_rules: retained except where explicitly refined by later versions

human_root_authority.execution_derived_process_repair: Validated E2+ execution evidence may create a bounded proposal, but does not itself reopen broad speculative process design or grant admission authority.

execution_first.default: Do not add speculative process rules. Prefer implementation, enforcement, audit and re-verification of existing rules.
execution_first.new_process_semantic_rule_requires: Validated execution-derived E2+ evidence of a distinct defect class, unless HUMAN explicitly reopens process-design review.

promotion_boundary: Process admission does not promote Garden v15.6, admit any pending source-design delta, create a delegation envelope, or modify immutable Garden v15.5.
